```{=html}
<script>
// Old-site addresses (jack.thomaslabs.co.uk) -> new locations. If the missing
// address matches one of these, forward the visitor instead of showing the 404.
(function () {
  var p = decodeURIComponent(location.pathname);
  var MOVED = [
    [/^\/Notes\/posts\/PDE@umn\/?/i,    "/notes/posts/locality-interatomic/"],
    [/^\/Notes\/posts\/body-order\/?/i, "/notes/posts/body-ordered/"],
    [/^\/Notes\/?(.*)$/,                "/notes/$1"],       // capital N -> lower case
    [/^\/teaching\/?$/,                 "/teaching.html"],
    [/^\/L'Aquila\/?/,                  "/notes/posts/screening-rhf/"]
  ];
  for (var i = 0; i < MOVED.length; i++) {
    if (MOVED[i][0].test(p)) {
      location.replace(p.replace(MOVED[i][0], MOVED[i][1]) + location.hash);
      return;
    }
  }
})();
</script>
```
